fields.FIR_Description: A oral complaint dated 2026-02-26 states that a group of persons allegedly attacked the complainant at Palar Park Industrial Area, causing injuries that required treatment, on 2026-02-26 around 22:50 hrs. Bharath Prakash approached Madurai South PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000118. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Praveen Sekar, using the number 9000000221. Items referenced in the complaint: CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Group allegedly confronted the victim following an earlier dispute.
fields.Keywords: group assault, injury, suspect, night, mobile number, industrial area, CCTV
